name: Cleave
description: On a melee hit, attack a second creature within 5 ft of the first (no ability modifier to damage). Once per turn.

name: Graze
description: On a miss, deal damage equal to the ability modifier used for the attack.

name: Nick
description: Make the Light property's extra attack as part of the Attack action instead of a Bonus Action. Once per turn.

name: Push
description: On a hit, push a Large or smaller creature up to 10 ft straight away from you.

name: Sap
description: On a hit, the creature has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before your next turn.

name: Slow
description: On a hit that deals damage, reduce the creature's Speed by 10 ft until your next turn.

name: Topple
description: On a hit, the creature makes a Con save (DC 8 + ability mod + PB) or falls Prone.

name: Vex
description: On a hit that deals damage, you have Advantage on your next attack roll against it before the end of your next turn.
